decisions.reason: Premium customer support is a low-cost extension of the firm's core service and its demand remains uncertain enough to keep the option open.
The software version management tool supports the firm's continuous development of management tools, so it is retained as an open option while its market potential is still unclear.
The data processing contract tool lies outside the core hosting business and carries ongoing legal-update costs, making its abandonment likely as results reveal limited value.
Scalable hosting for agencies is the firm's flagship option strongly aligned with its strategic direction, so it is kept open despite uncertainty.
